title: Understand review outcomes
summary: A GitHub review may comment, approve or request changes. Project branch rules determine which reviews are required before merging.
introduction: A GitHub review may comment, approve or request changes. Project branch rules determine which reviews are required before merging. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A GitHub review may comment, approve or request changes. Project branch rules determine which reviews are required before merging.

blocks.code:
Comment: asks a question or gives feedback
Approve: reviewer considers the change ready
Request changes: reviewer identifies work needed
blocks.title: Understand review outcomes

blocks.text: The outcomes communicate different levels of readiness. A review approval is evidence from a person, not a guarantee that every bug is absent.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write a clear change request for a missing empty-query test.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Resolve the reason for a review request; do not just hide its comment.
For more detail later, use this [GitHub further reading](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started).
